item.title: GRID4EARTH
item.description:
GRID4EARTH is an ESA Digital Twin Earth activity building a unified, standardized data infrastructure based on Discrete Global Grid Systems (DGGS)—HEALPix and Zarr—for Copernicus Sentinel and Destination Earth data.

Project site →

Consortium: IFREMER, CNRS, Simula, University of Tartu, GEORODE.

item.title: WaterSmartLand
item.description:
WaterSmartLand is an ERC Consolidator Grant developing a framework to find spatially optimal land management for nature-based solutions (wetlands, riparian buffer strips) to reduce agricultural nutrient runoff. It uses a DGGS data cube, machine learning, and process-based hydrological modelling.

Project site →

Led by Prof. Evelyn Uuemaa at the University of Tartu (2024–2029).
